  "rationale": "As a Managing Director at a small financial services firm (1-10 employees) using Freshsales for 1-2 years primarily to track sales, ease of use would be a high priority. Small businesses and executives generally value intuitive interfaces and minimal setup/training time. Freshsales is known for its user-friendly design, targeting SMBs. The 1-2 year usage indicates that the product was sufficiently easy to adopt and continue using. However, even user-friendly CRMs can have friction points, such as initial customization to fit specific sales workflows, integrating with specialized financial software, or a slight learning curve for more advanced features beyond basic sales tracking that an executive might desire for deeper insights. These factors suggest a rating leaning towards positive (4 or 5) but with a good chance of a 3 if minor frustrations accumulated."
